name: NOVALINERS ROUTE SCHEMA v0.1
note: Schema kontrak Route Ontology (internal-docs KONTRAK FINAL, 26 Sep 2026 — keputusan #1-#5 + review §3-§4 + Model B + tri-state). Deklaratif/adaitive mengikuti pola knowledge_schema.json: enums CLOSED SET + entities + invariants. Di-enforce oleh ontology/route/validate_route.py (bukan jsonschema — dependency tidak ada di venv, pola repo = validator manual). Sengaja TIDAK memuat: PROPOSED (T1/T2 belum dikunci — dilarang di enum RouteLineage), REOPEN/WAIT_FOR_DEPENDENCY/RESOLVE_EXECUTABILITY (INV-R19 — frontier bukan state machine), DONE_CREDITED/DONE_EXECUTED (INV-R8), NODE_PENDING_REQUIREMENT (bukan state RouteNode), route_score (INV-R1).

banned_values.$comment: Nilai yang DILARANG di field enum mana pun (dicek validator terhadap instance DAN terhadap enums schema ini sendiri — guard drift)

route_template.description: Grammar komposisi (knowledge layer) — BUKAN route. §3.1 kontrak.

strategy_id.note: strategy = execution ontology (B), bukan knowledge claim

applies.note: array predikat operator KB (rule_predicates.OPERATORS) -> APPLIES; tak ada yang match -> UNDETERMINED

not_applicable.note: predikat -> NOT_APPLICABLE; sitasi wajib dari evaluate_predicate = bukti positif INV-R2 by construction; keduanya match -> UNDETERMINED (konflik)

applies_when.note: applicability_rule 3-nilai (verdict owner 27 Sep): cerminkan satisfaction_rule/D-A1b; prosa DILARANG (INV-R16)

items.note: objek skema KB (D5 — identik registry); string 'source:chapter' DITOLAK (format T6)

reconciliation_key.description: Identity-bearing reconciliation criterion (bukan identity — identity = route_id). §3.2 + INV-R13/R14.

goal_anchor.note: requirement yang mewakili goal — wajib terikat di ≥1 node (INV-R4)

scope_anchor.note: referensi state ter-grounding (state:claim_xx), BUKAN label bebas LLM

route_lineage.description: Continuous navigation episode — satu route_id, satu terminal. §3.2.

motion.note: klasifikasi terasosiasi — BUKAN identity, tidak ada di reconciliation_key

revisions.note: current revision = max(revision_no) — frontier & projection hanya dari current; revision lama = historical structure (review P0-1)

reopened_from.note: episode baru dari CLOSED lineage dgn key sama (Model B, INV-R20) — BUKAN alias successor_of

applicability_eval.description: 3 nilai + evidence — NOT_APPLICABLE wajib berbukti positif (INV-R2).

label.note: render dari state — content, bukan identity

route_node.description: Unit eksekusi kontekstual — projection tanpa authority. §3.4. primary = resolves[0]; physical node_id hanya dibutuhkan bila primary kembar (INV-R18) atau jadi target depends_on ambigu.

node_id.note: physical key OPSIONAL — bukan identity ontologis

resolves.note: minItems 1: resolves=[] BUKAN RouteNode (CORRECT-1) — itu composition gap sebelum node terbentuk

depends_on.note: referensi node: node_id (utama) atau primary unik — ambigu = error

execution_context.note: wajib terbedakan bila primary kembar (INV-R18 — bagian semantik = audit, bagian struktural = node_id unik)

executability.note: DERIVED tri-state — hanya TRUE masuk frontier (INV-R19); TRUE hanya sah bila seluruh depends_on satisfaction=PRESENT (projection consistency — review hole-3)

execution_view.note: DERIVED dari Journey Ledger — bukan state node (INV-R8)

satisfaction_eval.description: Refleksi enum registry dalam satuan route — node TIDAK punya bahasa status sendiri (INV-R7/R8).

quality_flag.note: soft ABSENT saat hard semua PRESENT → PRESENT + flag ini; BUKAN PARTIAL

frontier_entry.description: Derived set — SET TERTUTUP tiga kind, tanpa ranking (INV-R10/R19). Frontier HANYA dihitung dari CURRENT revision (max revision_no); revision lama = historical, tidak ikut projection (review P0-1).

route_id.note: WAJIB semua kind — setiap opportunity berasal dari route tertentu; tanpa fallback lintas-route (review A)

node.note: node_id atau primary — hanya untuk kind EXECUTE/VERIFY

next_move.description: Selector over valid frontier — policy (info-gain dll) di M4, BUKAN kontrak ini.

frontier_ref.note: referential integrity: wajib menunjuk entry frontier yang benar-benar ada (dicek validator — review B; ini BUKAN ranking M4)

node_candidate.description: Kandidat node dalam RouteTemplate (knowledge/grammar layer — §3.1). Kunci lokal = candidate_key; node_id UUID = kunci FISIK instance, DITERBITKAN saat instansiasi (INV-R15) — DILARANG di template.

depends_on.note: referensi candidate_key (utama) atau primary unik — ambigu = error

strategy.description: Strategy registry (D5) — execution ontology, identity-bearing (INV-R14). motion diambil dari sini oleh bridge; template TIDAK membawa motion (T1.13).

requirement_ref.note: id requirement di Requirement Registry (mis. commercial.price, gtm.beachhead). Cross-check ke registry bila file registry ada (substrat bangun ulang).

invariants.INV-R6: resolves[] non-empty; setiap requirement ada di Registry + provenance valid
invariants.INV-R14: strategy_id di key; template_id TIDAK di key
invariants.INV-R18: primary kembar dalam 1 revision → node_id unik wajib; UNIQUE(route_id, primary) dilarang
invariants.INV-R19: frontier kind = set tertutup 3 nilai; FALSE/UNKNOWN executability bukan frontier
invariants.INV-R20: CLOSED tak pernah di-match; reopened_from ≠ successor_of

domain_vocabularies.motion: ontology/route/strategies.json#motion_vocabulary (dideklarasikan domain; bukan enum kontrak mesin route)
